note: Scenes of ours that no longer draw what Kinetic's draw, on purpose, with why. tools/kinetic/frames.mjs leaves them out of the compare; tools/audit.mjs is what holds them now.

scenes.agent: no "working" after the name and no made-up seconds beside a step: the kit writes no English of its own
scenes.between: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.browser: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.callouts: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.caption: its sentence wraps inside the frame's safe area
scenes.chart: a pie's or ring's names are a row under the disc, each beside its colour, not set round it where they ran into the title
scenes.checklist: its items and title are steps of the scale, and step down it when they are too wide
scenes.code: the window takes the frame's width in a square frame and for long lines, so the code is large enough to read
scenes.compare: no "Before" and "After" unless the film gives its own labels
scenes.drag: no "New video", "Generate" or "Drop files here" unless the film gives its own words; the drags keep pace with a short scene, so the line after them is read
scenes.endcard: the line under the name and the button are steps of the scale and never run past the frame
scenes.highlight: the faint word behind the line stays inside the frame
scenes.knockout: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.laptop: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.morph: an arrow on a button and nothing on a toast when the film gives no words for them
scenes.mosaic: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.notify: no "now" beside the app's name: the kit writes no English of its own
scenes.orb: its lines are a step of the scale, one size for all, and a line that left is gone
scenes.overlay: its caption stands in the foot of the safe area, not of the frame
scenes.palette: no English placeholder in the search bar
scenes.phones: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.prompt: the chip under the prompt is the film's name alone, not its name and the look's
scenes.slam: the small notes round the lines are large enough to read
scenes.steps: its type is steps of the scale (plan.js TYPE) and its list shares the title's column; a list too wide steps down the scale
scenes.title: the faint copy behind the title stays inside the frame, and a title of several words has none
scenes.ui-float: its drawn interface has bars where the film gives no words, not a made-up menu, people and figures
scenes.ui-macro: the chip is the film's name alone, not its name and the look's
